Tess H: Heads-up: OrionHealth onboarding blocked. During the guided setup their UI hangs while waiting for embeddings; they reported ~6 failures in a 15-minute window. Renewal conversation next week so this is high priority.
Marco D: Do we have an error sample from their side?
Tess H: Yes, here's the snippet they shared: ```POST /v1/embeddings
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Body: {\"input\":\"patient discharge summary...\"}``` Response: 504 after ~11s. No body.
Isha V: That tail is suspicious. Could be kernel fallback or NVidia memcpy stalls. Nate, any node-side restarts or OOMs in their region?
Nate R: Checking infra: small restart burst on node-gpu-3 at 03:17 UTC, but nothing matching every failure. No quota exceeded events. I'll pull pod logs.
Tess H: Customer tried lowering batch size and disabling client retries; still saw timeouts. They said when it fails the onboarding step goes blank and they have to refresh.
Marco D: Ops plan for CS handoff: 1) Short note to customer 2) Repro session with SRE + customer in 90m 3) Temporary routing to prewarmed pool + fallback option 4) Consider a one-time credit if SLA breached.
Isha V: I'll try a warm-pool pin for 45 minutes to see if tail improves. If we see stabilization we'll keep it and capture metrics.
ops-bot: [auto] Ticket ORH-7712 created: priority=P1 owner=customer-success link=https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/ORH-7712
Nate R: Pin applied at 1829010100 to warm-pool-us-east for 45m. Monitoring p95/p99.
Marco D: Draft comms please: short, empathetic, timeframe for update, repro invite, suggested temporary engineering tweak. Tess want to own sending?
Tess H: I'll draft. Suggest wording: "Hi Matt — sorry about the interruption. We're actively investigating an intermittent embed timeout affecting your setup. Engineers have pinned your requests to a warmed pool and will run a repro session at 13:30 PT. Next update in ~90 minutes. If impact meets SLA thresholds we'll issue a one-time credit." Thoughts?
Isha V: Add a brief suggested workaround for devs: "disable immediate retries, add exponential backoff with jitter, and as a short-term option switch to the lighter embed model (emb-small) for onboarding flows."
Marco D: Good. Also prepare a rollback play: unpin, revert routing, and remove tracing flags. Keep it <5 steps so AMs can read quickly.
Nate R: Warm-pool numbers: p95 dropped from 8.9s to 1.9s for ~60% of requests after pin. Still seeing sporadic ~10s spikes. Capturing GPU heap/alloc at spikes.
Tess H: Customer on call now; saw one success then a 502 on the next attempt. They're available for the repro at 13:30 PT. Sending the comms now.
ops-bot: [auto] Owner updated: customer-success -> Tess H; reminder to attach postmortem if ORH-7712 remains open >72h.
Marco D: Assignments: Tess H send comms + AM copy (ETA 15m); Isha V monitor warm-pool & collect traces (ETA 30m); Nate R gather node/pod logs & GPU metrics (ETA 45m); Marco D prep fallback routing + one-line runbook (ETA 1h).
Isha V: Found repeated memcpy stalls on gpu-3 around failure times: "[2026-06-08T03:17:22Z] memcpy 290ms; kvcache-miss seq=2; compile-fallback=true" Posting to ticket.
Tess H: Comms sent. AM confirmed Matt can join 13:30 PT repro. He appreciated the proactive pin.
Nate R: Uploaded logs to ORH-7712 attachments. Will keep monitoring.
Marco D: If repro still shows spikes propose Plan B: 1) route onboarding traffic to emb-small 2) impose client-side retry limit + jitter 3) schedule a maintenance window to investigate runtime caching.
Tess H: OK keeping this P1 through the repro. Will report back after call. Thanks all.
ops-bot: [auto] Note: if owners change, update ticket ORH-7712.
